title: Audit Trail Settings: Events, Retention and User Events | Orchard Core
description:
An audit trail is only useful when it records the right events, keeps them for the right time, and stores no more personal data than a site needs.

The Audit Trail settings of Orchard Core choose which events are recorded, which content types they apply to, how long events are kept, and which properties of a user are stored.

In this video:
• Where the Audit Trail and Users Audit Trail settings are
• Choosing the events, the content types and the client IP address to record
• Setting how long events are kept
• Choosing which user properties are stored, and how they are redacted
• Seeing the result in the Audit Trail list
